scope: Fail-closed continual foundation-contact supervisor and behavior-skill evolution loop
summary: The authored supervisor, local Forgejo/SkillHone setup, provider-aware evaluator, and promoted decision skill now form a reproducible behavior-evolution loop without promoting the still-unverified physical video model.
evidence: outputs/foundation-contact/20260812T214500Z-continual-supervisor-final-v2/supervisor-manifest.json completes in 0.0990 seconds, passes 5/5 spoof-rejection attacks, keeps 0/4 physical gates false, and selects calibrated-metric-camera-bridge-v1.
Native SkillHone outputs 20260812T213000Z, 20260812T213500Z, and 20260812T214000Z pass 4/4 probe, 3/3 test, and 4/4 adversarial respectively.
The same qwen3:4b, seed 42, probe split improves from strict 0/4 to 4/4; promotion-decision.json records a 1.0 score gain with no regressed UID and promote_physical_model=false.
Recorded mean probe item latency falls from 44.07 seconds to 4.36 seconds, a 10.11x improvement, after direct Ollama JSON routing.
Local Forgejo skill commit 91a1a5c and private evaluation commit fa9d4fa are pushed; ~/.skillhone/settings.json and the Forgejo token are mode 0600.
lessons: Stable decision reason codes and request-type precedence turn semantic agreement into a machine-verifiable supervisor ABI.
Provider-aware routing improves cost and reliability without relaxing any physical or adversarial gate.
Behavioral supervisor success must remain explicitly separate from metric camera, full-q, persistent-stem, and force evidence.
limitations: All four real physical evidence gates remain false on the 27.5-second candidate.
The private benchmark has eleven hand-authored cases and does not establish broad model generalization.
next_actions: Execute calibrated-metric-camera-bridge-v1 with an independent scale observation, then rerun the unchanged physical and adversarial contract on at least two independent groups.
